name: biz-opportunity
description: Backlog-to-build funnel: a mined opportunity becomes a sized, specified, gated bet. Kill early and cheaply.

steps.title: Size: {title}
steps.body: Market, effort, revenue/leverage estimate with receipts. Enough to decide pursue/hold/kill.

steps.title: PMF challenge: {title}
steps.body: Concrete user + trigger or kill recommendation. Says no more often than yes.

steps.title: Shape as feature plan: {title}
steps.body: If pursued: instantiate the feature template under this ticket and sequence it.

steps.title: Go / no-go
steps.body: Decision event with rationale on the root. The owner decides bets over one build-week.
